financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Underwritten public offering of 1,946,787 common shares at $1.34 (gross proceeds; net not given)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: On November 12, 2021, the Company, pursuant to an underwritten public offering, sold 1,946,787 shares of its common stock at a price of $1.34 per share for gross proceeds of approximately $2.6 million
